description: This Java class implements the MerchantConfigurationService interface, providing methods to manage and retrieve merchant configurations in an e-commerce system. It interacts with the data layer through a DAO, supports JSON serialization/deserialization, and uses Spring annotations for dependency injection.

classes.name: MerchantConfigurationServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of MerchantConfigurationService, facilitating CRUD operations and JSON serialization for merchant configurations.

methods.name: getMerchantConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a merchant configuration by key for a specific store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all configurations associated with a specific merchant store.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Lists configurations filtered by a specific type for a store.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new or updates an existing merchant configuration.

methods.name: getMerchantConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the merchant configuration as a MerchantConfig object, deserializing from JSON.

methods.name: saveMerchantConfig
methods.description: Serializes and saves a MerchantConfig object into the database.
